Name: Prismatic Junimo Plushies
Author: MissAnaira
Description: In celebration of Stardew Valley's 10 year anniversary and 2026 modfest, I uploaded a simple Content Patcher mod that retextures the junimo plush and small junimo plush to be prismatic colored. This mod is also uploaded in honor of the new 18+ Stardew Valley community discord server I made with some friends! To use this mod, make sure Content Patcher is downloaded and unzip into your Stardew Valley mods folder. Happy anniversary Stardew Valley!

Downloads.Description: Fixed the small plushies' saturation to be more consistent
